title: Q-LOOP-live-clock: Run Ultrastable's own seed heartbeat on a deployed runtime and report it
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** http:<runtime>/health shows a tick_runs row newer than 20 minutes and metrics_in_breach excludes M-tick-heartbeat
**Status:** open

Gap in component `self-host`: the local self-host tick passes (python3 -m foundation selfhost) but no deployed runtime of Ultrastable's own seed reports a tick. ultrastable.io/health is the site worker only. Deploy the seed worker with instances/ultrastable/objectives.json seeded, add its /health URL to doctrine/detectors.json as a detector, and register M-site-up style http metrics against it. Requires the Cloudflare route in deploy/routes.json; an unavailable credential is a recorded failure with a staged default, not a wait.
